picks.reason: This is a price play more than a projection play: Bo Nix projects for 1.46 TD passes, a hair under the line, but at +165 the model still gives him a 43.55% chance of two or more. His blended rate is 1.52, and the game script, with DEN expected to score 20.7, trims it by 3.7%. The fit has held up in this range, hitting 49.7% across 169 bets where it said about 44.5%. The market's no-vig chance is 35.67%; because this prop type is untested the desk leans only halfway and bets 39.2% against a 37.7% break-even on the over 1.5, an edge of 1.5 points. What the market may know better: the total fell 3 points since the open, and his recent 1.2 over 5 games plays no part in the number.
